35483-the-go-ahead-boys-on-smugglers-isl.title: Smugglers' Island
35483-the-go-ahead-boys-on-smugglers-isl.creator: Ross Kay
35483-the-go-ahead-boys-on-smugglers-isl.description: A book by Ross Kay. It is worth something to be up here where the air is so strong that you can almost bite it off. When we left Mackinac this morning one could hardly tell whether the island was upside down or not. He could see the reflections just as clearly in the water as he could see the island above."

arxiv-2103-07018.title: Interleaving Learning, with Application to Neural Architecture Search
arxiv-2103-07018.creator: Hao Ban, Pengtao Xie *
arxiv-2103-07018.description: Abstract Interleaving learning is a human learning technique where a learner interleaves the studies of multiple topics, which increases long-term retention and improves ability to transfer learned knowledge. Inspired by the interleaving learning technique of humans, in this paper we explore whether this learning methodology is beneficial for improving the performance of machine learning models as well.

arxiv-2111-06441.title: Galaxy rotation curves in the light of the Spinor Theory of Gravity
arxiv-2111-06441.creator: M. Novello, A. E. S. Hartmann, E. Bittencourt
arxiv-2111-06441.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Novello, A. E. S. Hartmann, E. Bittencourt. We analyze the recently obtained static and spherically symmetric solution of the Spinor Theory of Gravity (STG) which, in the weak field limit, presents an effective Newtonian potential that contains an extra logarithmic behavior. We apply this solution to the description of the galaxy rotation curves finding an interesting analogy with the dark matter halo profile proposed by Navarro, Frenk and White.

arxiv-2205-03136.title: Improved background model for the Large Area X-ray Proportional Counter (LAXPC) instrument on-board AstroSat
arxiv-2205-03136.creator: H. M. Antia, P. C. Agrawal, Tilak Katoch, R. K. Manchanda, Kallol Mukerjee, Parag Shah
arxiv-2205-03136.description: Abstract We present an improved background model for the Large Area X-ray Proportional Counter (LAXPC) detectors on-board AstroSat. Because of the large collecting area and high pressure, the LAXPC instrument has a large background count rate, which varies during the orbit.

arxiv-2301-11130.title: Overcoming Inverse-square Law of Gravitation and Luminosity for Interstellar Hyperspace Navigation by Celestial Objects
arxiv-2301-11130.creator: Nghi C. Nguyen
arxiv-2301-11130.description: Abstract Interstellar travel with hyperdrive or warp drive technologies presents navigating challenges when traveling speed approaches or exceeds the speed of light. Conventional methods such as inertia, magnetic, controlled gyros, visual or radar navigation, all have their limit at near-light speed due to inverse-square laws for gravitation, luminosity, and isotropic radiator.

arxiv-2306-17184.title: State space models can express n n -gram languages
arxiv-2306-17184.creator: Vinoth Nandakumar vinoth.90@gmail.com, Qiang Qu vincent.qu@sydney.edu.au, Peng Mi mipeng01@gmail.com, Tongliang Liu tongliang.liu@sydney.edu.au
arxiv-2306-17184.description: Abstract Recent advancements in recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have reinvigorated interest in their application to natural language processing tasks, particularly with the development of more efficient and parallelizable variants known as state space models (SSMs), which have shown competitive performance against transformer models while maintaining a lower memory footprint. While RNNs and SSMs (e.g.

arxiv-2307-04471.title: Phonon-assisted coherent transport of excitations in Rydberg-dressed atom arrays
arxiv-2307-04471.creator: Arkadiusz Kosior, Servaas Kokkelmans, Maciej Lewenstein, Jakub Zakrzewski, Marcin Płodzień
arxiv-2307-04471.description: Abstract Polarons, which arise from the self-trapping interaction between electrons and lattice distortions in a solid, have been known and extensively investigated for nearly a century. Nevertheless, the study of polarons continues to be an active and evolving field, with ongoing advancements in both fundamental understanding and practical applications.

arxiv-2310-14908.title: TOI-544 b: a potential water-world inside the radius valley in a two-planet system 2023 TOI-544 b: a potential water-world inside the radius valley in a two-planet system – 9
arxiv-2310-14908.creator: H. L. M. Osborne, V. Van Eylen, E. Goffo, D. Gandolfi, G. Nowak, C. M. Persson, J. Livingston, A. Weeks, E. Pallé, R. Luque, C. Hellier, I. Carleo, S. Redfield, T. Hirano, M. Garbaccio Gili, J. Alarcon, O. Barragán, N. Casasayas-Barris, M. R. Díaz, M. Esposito, J. S. Jenkins E. Knudstrup, F. Murgas,
arxiv-2310-14908.description: Abstract We report on the precise radial velocity follow-up of TOI-544 (HD 290498), a bright K star (V=10.8), which hosts a small transiting planet recently discovered by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS). We collected 122 high-resolution HARPS and HARPS-N spectra to spectroscopically confirm the transiting planet and measure its mass.

arxiv-2311-17492.title: Mergen : The First Manchu-Korean Machine Translation Model Trained on Augmented Data
arxiv-2311-17492.creator: Jean Seo, Sungjoo Byun, Minha Kang, Sangah Lee
arxiv-2311-17492.description: Abstract The Manchu language, with its roots in the historical Manchurian region of Northeast China, is now facing a critical threat of extinction, as there are very few speakers left. In our efforts to safeguard the Manchu language, we introduce Mergen , the first-ever attempt at a Manchu-Korean Machine Translation (MT) model.

arxiv-2402-13118.title: Multistatic OFDM Radar Fusion of MUSIC-based Angle Estimation
arxiv-2402-13118.creator: Martin Willame 1 2 , Hasan Can Yildirim 2 , Laurent Storrer 2 , François Horlin 2 , Jérôme Louveaux 1
arxiv-2402-13118.description: Abstract This study investigates the problem of angle-based localization of multiple targets using a multistatic OFDM radar. Although the maximum likelihood (ML) approach can be employed to merge data from different radar pairs, this method requires a high complexity multi-dimensional search process.

arxiv-2406-08473.title: Strategies for Pretraining Neural Operators
arxiv-2406-08473.creator: Anthony Zhou ayz2@andrew.cmu.eduDepartment of Mechanical EngineeringCarnegie Mellon University, Cooper Lorsung clorsung@andrew.cmu.eduDepartment of Mechanical EngineeringCarnegie Mellon University AmirPouya Hemmasian ahemmasi@andrew.cmu.eduDepartment of Mechanical EngineeringCarnegie Mellon Universi
arxiv-2406-08473.description: Abstract Pretraining for partial differential equation (PDE) modeling has recently shown promise in scaling neural operators across datasets to improve generalizability and performance. Despite these advances, our understanding of how pretraining affects neural operators is still limited; studies generally propose tailored architectures and datasets that make it challenging to compare or examine different pretraining frameworks.

arxiv-2410-22890.title: Possibility of quantum Hall effect in dense quark matter environments: A chiral model approach
arxiv-2410-22890.creator: Dani Rose J Marattukalam, Ashutosh Dwibedi, Sourodeep De and Sabyasachi Ghosh
arxiv-2410-22890.description: Abstract A high baryon density and strong magnetic fields are expected in peripheral collisions in heavy-ion collision experiments, such as the upcoming CBM experiment at FAIR in Germany and NICA in Russia. Such densities are also likely in the core of massive neutron stars, possibly with mixed quark-hadron phases.

arxiv-2412-16451.title: Correcting Large Language Model Behavior via Influence Function
arxiv-2412-16451.creator: Han Zhang, Zhuo Zhang, Yi Zhang, Yuanzhao Zhai, Hanyang Peng, Yu Lei, Yue Yu, Hui Wang, Bin Liang, Lin Gui, Ruifeng Xu
arxiv-2412-16451.description: Abstract Recent advancements in AI alignment techniques have significantly improved the alignment of large language models (LLMs) with static human preferences. However, the dynamic nature of human preferences can render some prior training data outdated or even erroneous, ultimately causing LLMs to deviate from contemporary human preferences and societal norms.

arxiv-2509-10218.title: Ionospheric Electron Heat Flow Modulates Planetary Ambipolar Electric Fields
arxiv-2509-10218.creator: Liangliang Yuan, Shuanggen Jin
arxiv-2509-10218.description: Abstract The ambipolar electrostatic field has long been recognized as a key driver of ion escape from planetary atmospheres. Elucidating the mechanisms responsible for the generation of this field is critical for understanding atmospheric escape and the evolution of habitability on terrestrial planets.

arxiv-2509-21359.title: Influence Guided Context Selection for Effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation
arxiv-2509-21359.creator: Jiale Deng, Yanyan Shen, Ziyuan Pei, Youmin Chen, Linpeng Huang
arxiv-2509-21359.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses large language model (LLM) hallucinations by grounding responses in external knowledge, but its effectiveness is compromised by poor-quality retrieved contexts containing irrelevant or noisy information. While existing approaches attempt to improve performance through context selection based on predefined context quality assessment metrics, they show limited gains over standard RAG.

arxiv-2604-20655.title: Sample entropy for graph signals: An approach to nonlinear analysis of graph signals
arxiv-2604-20655.creator: Mei-San Maggie Lei 1,* , John Stewart Fabila Carrasco 2 , Javier Escudero 1

arxiv-2605-30145.title: Supermassive black hole seeds from direct collapse of CDM-curvature peaks Preprint: APS/123-QED
arxiv-2605-30145.creator: Marco Galoppo a, Marco Bruni b,c, Tomohiro Harada d

pmc-10515001.title: Effects and action mechanisms of individual cytokines contained in PRP on osteoarthritis
pmc-10515001.creator: Zhengchao Wang, Pengfei Zhu, Bokai Liao, Hongbo You, Yu Cai
pmc-10515001.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is defined as a degenerative joint disease that can affect all tissues of the joint, including the articular cartilage, subchondral bone, ligaments capsule, and synovial membrane. The conventional nonoperative treatments are ineffective for cartilage repair and induce only symptomatic relief.

pmc-11632121.title: High‐risk cytogenetic abnormalities in multiple myeloma: PETHEMA‐GEM experience
pmc-11632121.creator: Veronica González‐Calle, Paula Rodriguez‐Otero, Maria J Calasanz, Manuela Guijarro, Joaquin Martínez‐López, Laura Rosiñol, Miguel T Hernández, Ana I Teruel, Mercedes Gironella, Albert Oriol, Javier de la Rubia, Ana P González‐Rodríguez, Joan Bargay, Felipe de Arriba, Luis Palomera, Marta‐Sonia Gonzá
pmc-11632121.description: This study examines the impact of cytogenetic abnormalities and their co‐segregation on the prognosis of newly diagnosed multiple myeloma patients. The analysis included 1304 patients from four different GEM‐PETHEMA clinical trials. Genetic alterations, such as t(4;14), t(14;16), del(17p), +1q, and del(1p), were investigated using FISH on CD38 purified plasma cells.

pmc-11888658.title: Identification of Filifactor Alocis in Periodontal Biofilms using Polymerase Chain Reaction Technique: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11888658.creator: Kaliaperumal Poorana, Nallasivam Lavanya, Munuswamy Jeeva Rekha, Rajendran Maheaswari
pmc-11888658.description: Background and Aim:Contribution of organisms causing periodontal disease remains unclear. Strong association has emerged between the presence of gram-positive Filifactor alocis (F.alocis) and periodontitis. Hence, we aimed to identify the presence of F.alocis in periodontal biofilms through PCR technique in health and disease.

pmc-12594170.title: Endogenic heat at Enceladus’ north pole
pmc-12594170.creator: Georgina Miles, Carly J. A. Howett, Francis Nimmo, Douglas J. Hemingway
pmc-12594170.description: The long-term survival of Enceladus’ ocean depends on the balance between heat production and heat loss. To date, the only place where a direct measurement of Enceladus’s heat loss has been made is at the south pole. Here, we show that the north pole also emits heat at a greater rate than can be explained by purely passive models.

pmc-12664749.title: Drug Management of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD): A Narrative Review
pmc-12664749.creator: Priyadarshan Singh, Paramjit Saini, Pravin P Kalyankar, Kamaljit R Kailey, Rohan Chauhan, Anupamdeep K Pannu, Navpreet Singh, Ketan Garg
pmc-12664749.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The exact underlying etiopathogenesis of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains unclear. Conventionally, autoimmune mechanisms have been linked with IBD, and thus various immunomodulatory or anti-inflammatory drugs have proven useful. The understanding of the complex gut mucosal immune system and the trafficking of leukocytes toward the intestine from lymphoid organs has allowed us to use molecular drugs that may target specific pathways, like the Janus kinase (JAK) pathway, phosphodiesterase, interleukins (IL)-12, 23, and adhesion molecules such as selectins.

pmc-12773434.title: Abstract 136: Antiplatelet Regimens for Secondary Prevention in Minor Ischemic Stroke or TIA: A Network Meta‐Analysis
pmc-12773434.creator: Hesham Kelani
pmc-12773434.description: IntroductionThere is increased risk of major cardiovascular events among patients with minor ischemic stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA) [1]. Antiplatelet drugs have been proven to reduce the risk of major cardiovascular events and highly recommended for secondary stroke prevention in this population [2]. However, using antiplatelets has shown an increase in the risk of bleeding events.

pmc-12815725.title: Modulating rheology and bioactivity in dermal fillers: the emerging role of platelet-rich plasma (PRP)
pmc-12815725.creator: Eduardo Anitua, Roberto Tierno, Mohammad Hamdan Alkhraisat
pmc-12815725.description: This review explores the concept of dilutional rheomodulation in dermal fillers with the addition of platelet-rich plasma (PRP) and its potential to improve both aesthetic and regenerative outcomes. PRP is a biological product rich in growth factors and cytokines derived from the patient’s own blood, which plays a significant role in tissue regeneration and healing.

pmc-13170708.title: Helper T cells and chemokines in elderly asthma—Mechanisms of airway inflammation and remodeling: A review
pmc-13170708.creator: Youhua Wu
pmc-13170708.description: Elderly bronchial asthma is a heterogeneous, often non-atopic disorder characterized by airway inflammation and remodeling influenced by age-related immune dysregulation. This review aims to elucidate the roles of helper T cells (Th cells) and chemokine networks in driving elderly asthma and to emphasize implications for precise diagnosis and targeted therapy.

pmc-13223653.title: FAP-CD40 and PD1-IL2v combination therapy reprograms immunologically cold tumors through de novo intratumoral T cell-dendritic cell clusters
pmc-13223653.creator: Thuy Trinh Nguyen, Harold Gómez, Mechthild Lutge, Emilio Yángüez, Tamara Hüsser, Sina Nassiri, Christine Trumpfheller, Sara Colombetti, Laura Codarri Deak, Pablo Umaña, Sònia Tugues, Ines Grazina de Matos, Leo Kunz
pmc-13223653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains a major challenge for immunotherapy due to its immunologically cold tumor nature, characterized by poor T cell infiltration and a highly suppressive tumor microenvironment. Here, we propose a novel strategy, combining fibroblast activation protein (FAP)-CD40 to activate dendritic cells (DCs) in the tumor microenvironment and programmed cell death protein-1 (PD1)-interleukin 2v (IL2v) to promote the expansion and differentiation of tumor-infiltrating T cells.

pmc-13356672.title: Dual-targeting bispecific antibodies against extramedullary myeloma: A hypothesis-driven commentary
pmc-13356672.creator: Shiqiong Zhou, Qinghua Ke
pmc-13356672.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights•79% ORR and 54% CR with dual BCMA/GPRC5D in EMD.•Dual targeting raises genetic barrier to concurrent antigen escape.•Dual targeting may mitigate T-cell exhaustion and improve synapse.•31% grade 3–4 infection rate highlights need for supportive care.Keywords: Extramedullary myeloma, Bispecific antibodies, Dual targeting, Bcma, Gprc5d, Resistance mechanisms For patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM) complicated by true extramedullary disease (EMD) – defined as non-contiguous soft-tissue plasmacytomas [1] – outcomes remain poor [2,3].

pmc-13460023.title: Self-reported hepatitis B diagnoses and vaccination history in trans and non-binary communities in Germany, the TASG-study* 2022
pmc-13460023.creator: Renke Biallas, Michael Brandl, Sofia Burdi, Jonas A. Hamm, Chris Spurgat, Kathleen Pöge, Viviane Bremer, Sandra Dudareva, Uwe Koppe
pmc-13460023.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundIn Germany, little is known about hepatitis B (HepB) prevalence and vaccination coverage among transgender and non-binary people (TNBP), a WHO-defined viral hepatitis key population. Our study aimed to assess self-reported HepB diagnoses, self-reported positive vaccination history, and potential predictors for a positive vaccination history in a subset of participants for whom the German standing committee on vaccination recommend HepB vaccination.MethodsWe analysed data from a 2022 cross-sectional online survey of TNBP in Germany.

pmc-13521834.title: Building an interpretable machine learning prognosis prediction model-based on baseline examinations of patients with esophageal cancer undergoing surgery
pmc-13521834.creator: Ruiyu Zhan, Qifeng Wang
pmc-13521834.description: To create an interpretable machine learning model based on non-invasive biomarkers for the early diagnosis and improved prognostic value of esophageal cancer. We gathered a private dataset at Sichuan Cancer Hospital, comprising 3204 esophageal cancer patients who underwent surgery. Baseline markers and preoperative biochemical blood tests were thoroughly reviewed.

pmc-13586819.title: Green Knoevenagel condensation of indolin-2-one derivatives using undivided electrochemical cell
pmc-13586819.creator: Robby Gus Mahardika, Ade Danova, Warinthorn Chavasiri, Elvira Hermawati, Anita Alni
pmc-13586819.description: Electrochemical Knoevenagel condensation has emerged as an attractive alternative to conventional condensation methods because it avoids the use of stoichiometric oxidants and enables reactions under mild conditions. However, a general electrochemical methodology for the condensation of indolin-2-one derivatives has not been established.

pmc-13595169.title: Trends in prevalence of cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome stages among US young adults, 2011–2020
pmc-13595169.creator: Rui Tang, Jaejin An, Brandon K Bellows, Andrew E Moran, Yiyi Zhang
pmc-13595169.description: BackgroundCardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome is a multistage, multisystem disorder defined by the American Heart Association (AHA). We examined recent trends in CKM stages among US young adults aged 18–39 years and assessed disparities by age, sex, and race/ethnicity.MethodsWe analyzed data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2011–2020.
